personal.name: Zunaid
personal.bio: Software Engineer specializing in building responsive and scalable websites.
personal.desc: I’m a Software Developer who turns ideas into clean, scalable, and reliable digital experiences. I enjoy solving complex problems and building things that just work.

experiences.description: Contributed to building responsive web interfaces using React.js and Tailwind CSS, integrated RESTful APIs, and supported backend services with Node.js and MongoDB.
Developed Java desktop applications including a dynamic Currency Converter and ATM banking system using Core Java, OOP principles, and robust exception handling.
Designed and developed responsive web interfaces using HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript, focusing on performance optimization, clean layouts, and cross-browser support.

thoughts.title: About Problem-Solving
thoughts.description: I see programming as a creative process where every challenge is an opportunity to craft a solution. For me, solving problems is not just about fixing issues but building something that is scalable, efficient, and impactful. I strive to write clean, reusable code that simplifies complexity

thoughts.title: On Continuous Learning
thoughts.description: Technology evolves rapidly, and I believe in staying curious and adapting to change. Whether it's learning new frameworks, understanding complex systems, or diving into new programming languages, I see every learning opportunity as a step toward growth. My journey is fueled by the desire to keep improving and staying ahead of the curve.

thoughts.title: Collaboration and Innovation
thoughts.description: I value the power of collaboration in creating innovative solutions. Working with others allows me to see problems from different perspectives and develop more creative ideas. My ultimate goal is to contribute to projects that not only meet business goals but also make life easier for users.
